lines.text: The LORD tells Moses and Aaron that the Israelites must camp around the Tent of Meeting at a distance.
Judah camps on the east side with Issachar and Zebulun, and the camp of Judah sets out second.
Reuben camps on the south side with Simeon and Gad, and this camp sets out second.
The Tent of Meeting travels in the middle with the Levites, and Ephraim camps on the east side.
Dan camps on the north side and sets out last, and the Israelites do everything the LORD commanded Moses.
